mission_02: Variational Quantum Circuits (VQCs) are parameterized quantum circuits optimized classically, forming the basis of near-term quantum machine learning. Each layer applies parameterized single-qubit rotations (RY, RZ) followed by entangling CNOT gates, creating a trainable quantum model. The circuit's output is measured as expectation values of observables, which serve as predictions. Training uses the parameter-shift rule: the gradient of an expectation value with respect to a parameter theta is (f(theta + pi/2) - f(theta - pi/2)) / 2, computed by evaluating the circuit at shifted parameter values. In this mission, you implement a VQC with RY and RZ rotation gates, layered architecture with entangling CNOTs, expectation value computation, loss calculation, and gradient computation using the parameter-shift rule for classical optimization.
